title: 第407章 厉延霏的婆家
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

厉野早训完回来，就发现一家子人全坐在院子里，眼神齐刷刷地盯着他，表情一个比一个古怪。

他走到水池边洗了手，又洗了把脸，忍不住回头看了看：“我脸上有东西？”

又不太确定地照了照洗脸架上的镜子，“没有啊。”

厉小棠没忍住，先笑了出来：“哥，恭喜你啊，你要当爸了。”

厉野愣了一下，随即眼里炸开一片惊喜。

“媳妇，你怀孕了？！”

厉野大步走了过来，弯腰，两只胳膊一抄，稳稳地把林见微公主抱了起来。

林见微身体突然腾空，本能搂住他的脖子，“哎！你干什么！放我下来！”

方安雅也吓了一大跳，赶紧起身，一巴掌拍在厉野胳膊上：“哎哟喂！她现在身子重，经不起你这么折腾！”

厉野这才轻手轻脚把人放下来，“我高兴。”

“高兴也不能胡来啊，这万一摔了……”方安雅念叨着，又赶紧拍了拍自己的嘴，“呸呸呸！平平安安的，都平平安安的。”

林见微说：“还不确定呢，得去医院查了才知道。”

“那我们现在就去。”

厉野说着，拉起她的手就往外走。

“你还没吃饭。”

“不吃了。”

两句话的功夫，两人已经出了院子。

方安雅在后面喊：“小心着点！别颠着她！”

厉野把人护着上了车，又往她腰后、屁股底下各塞了个软垫，细心备至。

一路上，林见微看着他压都压不下去的嘴角，觉得好笑。

“以前怎么没看出来你这么喜欢孩子？”

“也说不上喜欢。”厉野想了想，“但和你的孩子，不一样。”

林见微嘴角弯了弯，手抚上小腹，这感觉真奇妙。

两人熟门熟路直奔潘心茹的诊室，做完全套孕检。

“恭喜你们，确实是怀孕了，刚满一个月，回去好好养着，别太累，前三个月注意休息，不要剧烈运动。”

林见微从潘心茹手里接过检查单。

看来是没有检查出来她怀的是双胎。

也是，现在医疗设备不行，得等到肚子大了，能听到胎心的时候，才能知道是双胎。

得到确切的答案，厉野更是高兴地手都不知道往放。

又细细问了潘心茹一些怀孕后的注意事项，拿笔一一记了下来。

从诊室出来，就一直拿着笔记在背。

一边背还一边叮嘱林见微：“媳妇，你要少吃多餐。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Li Ye came back from early training, he found the whole family sitting in the yard, staring at him with their expressions getting weirder than the last.

He walked to the sink and washed his hands and face. He couldn't help but look back: "Is there something on my face?"

He looked at the mirror on the washstand uncertainly and said, "No."

Li Xiaotang couldn't hold back and laughed first: "Brother, congratulations, you are going to be a father."

Li Ye was stunned for a moment, and then his eyes burst into surprise.

"Daughter-in-law, are you pregnant?!"

Li Ye strode over, bent down, raised his arms, and firmly picked up Princess Lin Jianwei.

Lin Jianwei's body suddenly jumped into the air, and Ben Ben hugged his neck, "Hey! What are you doing! Put me down!"

Fang Anya was also startled. She quickly stood up and slapped Li Ye on the arm: "Ouch! She's heavy now and can't stand your torment like this!"

Li Ye then put the person down gently, "I'm happy."

"You can't act recklessly when you're happy. What if it falls..." Fang Anya muttered, and quickly patted her mouth, "Bah, bah, bah! Everything is safe, everything is safe."

Lin Jianwei said: "I'm not sure yet. I'll have to go to the hospital to check."

"Then let's go now."

Li Ye said, took her hand and walked out.

"You haven't eaten yet."

"I won't eat anymore."

In two words, the two of them had already left the yard.

Fang Anya shouted from behind: "Be careful! Don't bump her!"

Li Ye protected her into the car and stuffed soft cushions behind her waist and under her buttocks, carefully.

Along the way, Lin Jianwei looked at the corners of his mouth that couldn't be suppressed and found it funny.

"Why didn't I see you like children so much before?"

"I can't say I like him." Li Ye thought for a moment, "But it's different from your child."

Lin Jian slightly curved the corners of his mouth and put his hand on his lower abdomen. It felt so wonderful.

The two knew each other well and went straight to Pan Xinru's clinic to do a complete pregnancy test.

"Congratulations, you are indeed pregnant. It's just one month old. Go back and take good care of yourself. Don't be too tired. Pay attention to rest in the first three months and avoid strenuous exercise."

Lin Jianwei took the checklist from Pan Xinru.

It seems that the test did not reveal that she was pregnant with twins.

Also, because the medical equipment is not good now, we have to wait until the belly is full and the fetal heartbeat can be heard to know that it is twins.

After getting the exact answer, Li Ye was so happy that he didn't even know where to put his hands.

He also asked Pan Xinru carefully about some things to pay attention to after pregnancy, and took a pen to write them down one by one.

After coming out of the clinic, I kept taking notes and memorizing them.

While carrying it back, she told Lin Jianwei: "Daughter-in-law, you have to eat less and eat more often."
